miss_explanations.region: hub recess beside one slot entry (scan->CAD whole-part max, Z1/Z4 max)
miss_explanations.cause: declared unmodelled local feature (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-01): 36 scan points over 0.8 mm, max 1.177; asymmetric (1 of 4 entries), so feature vs damage cannot be told without a photo. Outside the recess the masked scan->CAD has 8 isolated points over 0.8 (max 0.969, no cluster >= 20 pts). Whole-part masked scan->CAD p95 0.213 passes
miss_explanations.options: (a) human accepts the recess miss (ACCEPT-BAND); (b) photo of the drive end -> model it as a feature (it3) or declare damage; (c) full-res scan

miss_explanations.region: slot foot/flare/floor coverage, CAD->scan observable (Z4, idler end)
miss_explanations.cause: COVERAGE, not geometry: 97.6 % of masked CAD->scan points over 0.8 lie in the slots; 8757 of them have no scan point within 0.3 mm / 1 mm z (only 22 do). These are undercut flare/foot surfaces and floor spans the decimated scan never saw, outside the M6c bins (M6c covers only bins where an occupant hides the floor). Diagnostic only: masked CAD->scan without slot interiors p95 0.206. The ray test counts many of these surfaces as line-of-sight observable
miss_explanations.options: (a) full-res scan or a re-scan with cleaned slots aimed into the slots; (b) a declared coverage-gap mask located from the scan (intake decision, with leave-one-out); (c) human acceptance. More geometry cannot fix it

miss_explanations.region: Z2 hub discs, Z3 idler bore/counterbore (small scan->CAD overs)
miss_explanations.cause: hub step/rim edge break (declared simplification, hub-step chamfer) and bore wall near the assumed bottom; 215 CAD->scan points over 0.8 at z >= 158 outside the slots (bore wall just above the masked bottom, counterbore/slot crossing)
miss_explanations.options: optional it3: model the hub-step chamfer; bore depth needs a caliper or photo

claim_boundary: Not deliverable without a recorded ACCEPT-BAND. This is an iteration-2, inspection-only (decimated), scan-only result. The slot-foot shape is supported by the scan only where the foot was seen. The hub recess is absent from the CAD. Not fit for tooling or fit checks of the slots or the drive-end recess. No claim about the unscanned rim end face, hub interior, tuft-hole depth or bore bottom.
independence: Verify ran in a separate agent context from the builder, with its own code: stl-re-verify scripts, its own ICP, and its own masks/zones/datum spec. No builder number, params.json, PARAM_TABLE, build_log or measure/figures were used. model.py was only grepped. Organisational independence is NOT claimed: the same orchestrator session spawned both builder and verifier.
